preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership)
Contract must hold some balance of its own tokens

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the transferTokens() function to transfer the contract's token balance to any recipient address (including the attacker's wallet). This function bypasses normal fee mechanisms and allows the owner to drain tokens accumulated from fees. First ensure the contract has token balance from fee accumulation, then call transferTokens(attacker_address, contract_balance).
